#define MOD 1000000007
#define SET(x,y) memset(x,y,sizeof(x));
#define LL long long int
#define ULL unsigned LL
#define PII pair<int, int>

class Matrix {
public:
    int m[31][31];
    int N;
    Matrix(int size) {
        N = size;
        memset(m, 0, sizeof(m));
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            m[i][i] = 1;
    }
    Matrix* multiply(Matrix b);
} *M[71][31];

Matrix* Matrix::multiply(Matrix b) {
    int i, j, k;
    Matrix* result = new Matrix(N);
    for (i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        for (j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            LL sum = 0;
            for (k = 0; k < N; k++) {
                sum += m[i][k] * (LL)b.m[k][j];
                sum %= MOD;
            }
            result->m[i][j] = sum;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

LL power[100];

int main() {
    int i, j, l;
    LL n;
    int k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    for (i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        M[0][i] = new Matrix(k + 1);
        for (j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
            M[0][i]->m[i][j] = 1;
        }
    }
    power[0] = 1;
    power[1] = k;
    int lg = 2;
    while (power[lg - 1] <= n / k) {
        power[lg] = power[lg - 1] * k;
        lg++;
    }
    for (i = 1; i < lg; i++) {
        M[i][0] = new Matrix(k + 1);
        for (j = 1; j < k; j++) {
            M[i][j] = *M[i - 1][j - 1]->multiply(*M[i][j - 1]);
        }
        Matrix* cpro = new Matrix(k + 1);
        for (j = k - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
            cpro = *cpro->multiply(*M[i - 1][j]);
            M[i][j] = *M[i][j]->multiply(*cpro);
        }
    }
    Matrix* ans = new Matrix(k + 1);
    int cc = 0;
    for (i = lg - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        while (power[i] <= n) {
            n -= power[i];
            ans = *M[i][cc]->multiply(*ans);
            cc++;
            cc %= k;
        }
    }
    LL result = 0;
    for (i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
        result += ans->m[i][k];
        result %= MOD;
    }
    cout << result << endl;
